scope: Inert exact field extraction from retained independently reviewed candidates; not a new author or final D/P/M/V approval.

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can plan, carry out and evaluate a project on a selected topic in economics and law using subject knowledge.
fields.titleEn: Carry out an economics-and-law project

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can apply basic project-management methods in a team to achieve results and use digital media according to the needs of the project.
fields.titleEn: Apply project management in a team

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the functions of prices in specific markets and justify advantages of decentralised systems over centrally directed economic systems.
fields.titleEn: Explain price functions and decentralised coordination

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can represent macroeconomic relationships using the circular-flow model and formulate cause-and-effect relationships in appropriate economic language.
fields.titleEn: Represent macroeconomic relationships in a circular-flow model

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can analyse statistics on economic, social and environmental policy topics and assess what conclusions they support.
fields.titleEn: Analyse economic, social and environmental statistics

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can assess journalistic texts and cartoons on economic, social and environmental policy topics with regard to their evidential value, intention and relationship to the social market economy.
fields.titleEn: Assess media contributions on economic policy

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can assess current rules and decisions in public and private law with regard to the functions of law, rule-of-law principles and a fair balancing of interests.
fields.titleEn: Assess legal rules and the rule of law

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can analyse the content, limits and underlying values of property as an institutional element of the social market economy using specific examples.
fields.titleEn: Analyse property institutions in the social market economy

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can analyse the effects of exchange-rate fluctuations on private households and businesses.
fields.titleEn: Analyse exchange-rate fluctuations for households and businesses

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can analyse journalistic texts and cartoons on international economic relationships with regard to their evidential value and intention and situate them in their political context.
fields.titleEn: Assess media contributions on international economic relationships

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can analyse and evaluate current economic and legal developments using subject knowledge, including consideration of digitalisation.
fields.titleEn: Evaluate current economic and legal developments

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can develop future scenarios and options for shaping them and assess these in light of their assumptions and surrounding conditions.
fields.titleEn: Assess future scenarios and options for shaping them

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can contribute responsibly to shaping the economic future as an informed and independent citizen.
fields.titleEn: Help shape the economic future responsibly

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can assess the importance of international economic relationships for Germany and analyse the effects of changes in foreign trade using the circular-flow model.
fields.titleEn: Assess Germany’s international economic relationships

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can analyse participants in money and capital markets with regard to their importance for the economy.
fields.titleEn: Analyse participants in money and capital markets

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can analyse rules of the social market economy from an institutional-economics perspective and use this perspective to deepen their understanding of familiar economic relationships and legal norms.
fields.titleEn: Apply institutional economics to the social market economy

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can relate real social and economic decision situations to basic game-theory models and derive possible strategies for decision-makers from them.
fields.titleEn: Apply basic game-theory models to decision situations

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can develop strategies for their own and collective action based on game-theoretic reasoning.
fields.titleEn: Develop strategies using game theory

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can compare their own interests, values, abilities and ideas about the future with the requirements of careers and the world of work.
fields.titleEn: Compare a career-choice profile with work requirements

fields.descriptionEn: The learner can make targeted use of media, advisory services and institutions for career and study choices and derive reasoned plans for their future from them.
fields.titleEn: Use information sources for career and study choices
